Title: [LSJ] To what extent can i help while i judge?

Messages.Author: Brian Skelly
Messages.Body:
Ive been asked by my local Prince to Judge our next tournament. I have
made up some pretty nice sheets to keep a track of everything (ie. a
tickbox in the corner if Ancient Influence has been played etc.) but
can i do some of the following to not only help the players, but to
also help me remember some things...

e.g.

1. can i place a counter in front of a player to remind me/them they
have played a "Master: Out of Turn" ?
..... i cant think of any other examples? can anyone else?

and..

Can anyone think of anything else that should go on a 'table sheet'
besides

1. has this card been played yet?
2. meth. archon number
3. who got ousted by who and & when
4. start time & finish
5. misc. notes

I am hoping to get a finalised design before the AU nations start to
roll in, as this could be a valuable sheet to any judge as it would
keep easy & effective records of things (like if a "only playable once
per game").

Thankyou,

Brian Skelly

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:

> Ive been asked by my local Prince to Judge our next tournament. I have

> 1. can i place a counter in front of a player to remind me/them they
> have played a "Master: Out of Turn" ?

You should not interfere in the game (unless a player violates a rule,
of course).
If you want to take notes (including placing markers on a diagram of the
table to indicate whatever you want), that's fine.
